annotations.title: Finish a modpack upload and install it

description: Installs the uploaded file as the server's modpack, replacing loader, version and mods at the next restart; a backup is taken first. Pass uploadId, key and each ETag, and replace to swap out a modpack that is already set. Returns the server.

curseforgeProjectId.description: CurseForge project the .zip was downloaded from, to show its logo.

key.description: key returned by the start call; pass it unchanged.

parts.description: One entry per uploaded piece, in partNumber order.

etag.description: ETag header from that piece's PUT response, quotes included.

partNumber.description: Piece number from the start call, from 1.

replace.description: Swap out the server's current modpack in the same step.

uploadId.description: uploadId returned by the start call for this file.

serverId.description: Server id: the id field from listServers.

name: completeModpackUpload
title: Finish a modpack upload and install it
